a.lede: The spacecraft stores data on an eight-track tape, but it’s managed to stay in contact with scientists for decades. Now, it’s the first human-made object to travel a light-day away from Earth.
a.title: Voyager 1 Beat the Odds and Is Still Working a Light-Day Away From Earth

b.lede: It now takes 24 hours to send a message to Voyager 1, as it reaches a distance that's one light-day away from our planet.
b.title: NASA's Voyager 1 space probe is now one light-day away from Earth
